%-----------SUMMARY-----------
\section{Summary}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=0.15in, label={}]
  \item[] \small First-year Ph.D. student at UC Santa Cruz (advisor: Dr. Ian Lane) researching LLM post-training,
  factuality, and safety-focused evaluation of LLMs and agents. Work spans agent benchmarks, reward hacking in
  agent evaluation, and user dependence on supportive LLMs, with a co-first-author ICLR 2027 submission and
  1st place at UC Berkeley AgentBeats 2026. Brings 6 years of production ML engineering at 100M+ user scale.
\end{itemize}
